ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: The figure is a transition-state structure. On the left there is a six-membered ring, with HO and R1 labeled on the ring, and on the lower right side there is an exocyclic C=O; the right side of the six-membered ring is connected to a stereocenter/vertex carbon. In the right fragment, this vertex carbon is connected upward to CO2R3 and to the right to a carbon bearing H and a substituent; this carbon forms C=N with N, and N is further connected to R2. There are also curved arrows and a positively charged H in the figure, but the problem requires ignoring the arrows and excluding bonds involving hydrogen. Reasoning: count heavy-atom bonds by regions according to the specified method. The left six-membered ring itself has 6 intra-ring bonds. The left-ring substituent bonds have 4 bonds: ring-O (the O-H in HO is not counted), ring-R1, exocyclic ring-C=O, and the bond from the ring to the right vertex carbon, so the left side totals 10 bonds. The right fragment has 8 heavy-atom bonds: vertex carbon-CO2R3 carboxyl carbon, vertex carbon-imine carbon, ester C=O, ester C-O, O-R3, imine C=N, imine carbon to unlabeled carbon substituent, N-R2. The total is 6 + 4 + 8 = 18.

raw_record.question_text:
In the transition-state structure shown in the image, calculate the total number of bonds in the structure, including single, double, and triple bonds but excluding those involving hydrogen.

Note: Disregard arrows. Consider all components present in the transition-state structure shown in the image.

method.method_draft: Count heavy-atom bonds by regions. First count the six bonds around the left six-membered ring. Add the left-ring substituent bonds: ring-O of HO, ring-R1, exocyclic ring-C=O, and the bond from the ring to the right-hand stereocenter/apical carbon. Then count the right fragment: apical carbon to CO2R3 carbon, apical carbon to imine carbon, ester C=O, ester C-O, O-R3, imine C=N, imine carbon to its unlabeled carbon substituent, and N-R2. Sum these regional counts while excluding O-H and C-H bonds to obtain 18.
